mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or FEDFUNDS begins rising before returns peak.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward crossing of the unemployment rate threshold (6.5%) triggers a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 trading days as investor sentiment shifts toward recession risks.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not cross 6.5% threshold within 3 months or 5-day returns remain non-negative.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in both demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indices signals robust economic expansion, amplifying equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction effect (e.g., correlation < 0.5 or p-value > 0.05 in regression) or 60-day returns not significantly positive.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (e.g., FEDFUNDS > 4.0% for 3 months), rising interest rates reduce discount rates on future cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly negative in tightening periods or FEDFUNDS does not sustain >4.0% for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in labor demand (PAYEMS) exceeding 1.5 million in three months signals overheating labor markets, prompting risk aversion and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS does not exceed 1.5 million threshold within 3 months or 5-day returns remain non-negative.

mechanism_narrative: Co-expansion of both personal consumption (GDPC1) and business investment (RSAFS) drives robust demand growth, enhancing equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction effect (e.g., p-value > 0.05 in regression) or 60-day returns not significantly positive.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment, high-growth labor market regime (UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS > 130,000), strong labor demand and tight labor supply create upward pressure on wages, reducing corporate profits and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Regime conditions not sustained or 20-day returns not significantly negative.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent expansion in supply (INDPRO) and monetary easing (FEDFUNDS decline) lowers discount rates on capital, boosting equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction effect (e.g., correlation < 0.5 or p-value > 0.05) or 60-day returns not significantly positive.
